SELECT 
  event.type,
  AVG(CAST(budget.spent AS REAL) / CAST(budget.amount AS REAL)) as avg_ratio,
  AVG(CAST(budget.spent AS REAL) / CAST(budget.amount AS REAL)) - 
  (SELECT AVG(type_avg) FROM (
    SELECT AVG(CAST(budget.spent AS REAL) / CAST(budget.amount AS REAL)) as type_avg
    FROM budget 
    JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id 
    WHERE budget.spent != 0 
    GROUP BY event.type
  )) as difference
FROM budget 
JOIN event ON budget.link_to_event = event.event_id 
WHERE budget.spent != 0 
GROUP BY event.type
